scope: Read-only methodology boundary and minimal acceptance framework; no data inventory, business implementation, empirical efficacy or release acceptance

required_decisions.decision: One first primary factor and one primary outcome; recommend industry residual first and next eligible HK open-to-close as primary; preclose-to-open is separate informational diagnostic, not executable post-open profit. Company-link factor separately evaluated, no composite score.
freeze: US return session and price adjustment basis
beta estimator/intercept/window/min observations and estimate end
HK exposure rule and missing policy
primary HK holding horizon and outcome benchmark
required_decisions.acceptance: Each factor reconstructible from saved inputs with a causal beta fitted through prior US sessions; no fitting the current shock or choosing formula by held-out returns.

required_decisions.decision: Assign each of existing 33 US sources a declared signal role. ETF theme/industry exposure and issuer economic edges are separate types.
freeze: coarse industry versus explicit fine theme
one designated proxy or fixed justified multi-exposure weights
normalization fitted only on preceding data
required_decisions.acceptance: ETF need not have issuer collaboration, but HK exposure needs evidence. Duplicate/overlapping ETFs cannot silently give repeated votes; absent weight evidence use a declared categorical exposure rather than invented revenue percentages.

required_decisions.decision: Use actual eligible sessions and availability, not matching date strings.
required_decisions.acceptance: Session ended, data received, and classification/relation usable all no later than cutoff. DST, US-only/HK-only holidays, late arrival and unknown publication precision fixtures must have predetermined outcomes. RETROSPECTIVE mode does not assert natural preopen/PIT readiness.

required_decisions.decision: Preserve historical membership and classification versions, or explicitly limit the experiment to a current fixed-universe retrospective question.
freeze: HK Connect membership effective interval and known-at time
HK industry/business classification effective interval and known-at time
required_decisions.acceptance: Current industry labels, new 2026-10-13 reviews or current 692 membership cannot be retrospectively called contemporaneously known. No historical versions means PIT CANNOT_CONFIRM; prospective frozen mapping and forward observations are allowed, historical causal efficacy is not established.

required_decisions.decision: Company links require source-to-target direction and separate economic interpretation.
freeze: materiality evidence when claiming revenue sensitivity
single-factor propagation hypothesis for each supported edge family
required_decisions.acceptance: Preserve factual approved tuples, quote/locator/raw SHA and contrary evidence. PRIORITY/WATCH are human research classifications, not automatically factor signs, weights or positive-return predicates. No proof of materiality/direction means only relation observation or explicitly untested hypothesis, not fabricated quantitative exposure.

required_decisions.decision: Freeze chronological evaluation and state labels before empirical iteration.
freeze: training/validation/sealed sample dates and sample IDs
same-date comparable baseline intersection plus full-universe coverage
fee/slippage assumptions only for claimed executable portfolio results
required_decisions.acceptance: No random time split; labels overlapping a boundary must not train against validation/holdout outcomes. Report dated IC/rank-IC, spread, uncertainty respecting time dependence, coverage and failed periods; for portfolio claims add turnover/net costs. Report all tried variants and do not repeatedly tune on sealed results. More picks/API200 is not efficacy.

stage_gates.pass: Source/calendar/scope/classification references and SHA plus explicit missing fields; zero and missing distinguished, no new producer.
Industry exposure and company directed relation records separately versioned and independently reviewed; known-at limitations retained.
Formula/window/labels/splits/acceptance frozen and reproducible; empirical result separately PASS/FAIL/CANNOT_CONFIRM, never inferred from engineering success.
Saved fixed-cutoff inputs reproduce factor values, coverage and candidate ranks; label candidate-unvalidated when efficacy gate not satisfied, preserve unknown stocks.
Counts/filters/details use saved US-factor rows with formula/version/session/source/exposure and research status; independent from oversold40 results, no aggregate promotion.
Only after prior engineering acceptance, demonstrate timely source availability and natural-slot consumption separately; no natural claim from manual replay.

minimum_counterexamples: future classification/review excluded at earlier cutoff
signal received after cutoff cannot preopen consume
DST and asymmetric holidays join by session not calendar string
missing sector exposure does not become zero
duplicate ETF proxy does not duplicate stock membership
company relation direction/unknown sign not auto-positive
current membership retrospective run never labeled historical PIT
same input SHA reproduces factor/rank and old oversold40 unchanged
scope_preserved: existing 33 US sources and approved HK Connect scope

primary_sources_verified.supports: Original study uses prior public material customer-supplier links and monthly customer-momentum; does not prove all partnership edge or HK overnight efficacy.
SOXX ETF sector-proxy definition, not issuer partnership or HK propagation proof.
ETF momentum implementation context; cannot substitute empirical HK cross-market validation.
